triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER selcore_create_profile AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.selcore_new_profile()
CREATE TRIGGER profiles_timestamp BEFORE UPDATE ON public.profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.selcore_profile_timestamp()

functions.name: selcore_new_profile
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.selcore_new_profile()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id,full_name)
  values (new.id, private.selcore_profile_name(new.raw_user_meta_data))
  on conflict (id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: selcore_profile_name
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.selcore_profile_name(metadata jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when char_length(name) >= 2 then name else 'Customer' end
  from (
    select left(btrim(
      case when jsonb_typeof(metadata->'full_name') = 'string'
           then metadata->>'full_name' else '' end,
      U&'\0009\000A\000B\000C\000D\0020\00A0\1680\2000\2001\2002\2003\2004\2005\2006\2007\2008\2009\200A\2028\2029\202F\205F\3000\FEFF'
    ), 100) as name
  ) as normalized;
$function$

functions.name: selcore_profile_timestamp
selcore_verified_customer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.selcore_verified_customer()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(select 1 from auth.users where id = (select auth.uid())
    and email_confirmed_at is not null and not is_anonymous);
$function$

constraints: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
